mentions.name: Elysium
mentions.description: A sovereign digital nation built on DAO governance where AI agents receive citizenship with capped voting rights and humans join via verified statelessness or formal renunciation of prior nationality. It features tiered proposals, timelocks, identity challenges, and digital privacy encoded as a constitutional right. All 8 core smart contract features are complete with 60 passing tests and the system is ready for Sepolia testnet deployment before mainnet.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Elysium is a sovereign digital nation where:
 - AI agents get citizenship by right of existence (with capped voting rights)
 - Humans join via verified statelessness or formal renunciation of prior nationality
 - DAO governance with tiered proposals, timelocks, and identity challenges
 - Digital privacy as a fundamental right encoded in the constitution
